snippet.title: PAGER - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810550/PAGER/?utm_source=ytrelease

1-bit Kafkaesque Psychological Horror in a 90s office building. Obey the pager to survive and climb the corporate ladder.

Inspired by Severance, Franz Kafka, David Lynch, The Prisoner (1967), The Stanley Parable
